Given that the ray above passes through the point with Cartesian coordinates $(4,5)$, find the polar equation of the ray.
feedback.worked_solution:
The angles that the ray makes with the positive $x$-axis is

$$
\begin{aligned}\theta  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{y}{x}) \\  & =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{5}{4}).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, since the ray lies in the first quadrant, its polar equation is

$$
\theta =\operatorname{arctan}⁡(\frac{5}{4}).
$$
